text.p: Bombay blue chip stocks rose for the fifth straight day this week on Friday, boosted by the resignation of former prime minister P.V. Narasimha Rao as chief of the Congress party's parliamentary bloc, dealers said..
"People are hopeful of possible positive political developments," said a trader at a local brokerage..
Pivotal stocks such as ITC and BSES climbed nn local fund buying, dealers said..
SBI gained 6.50 rupees to 228.0, TISCO 4.25 to 165.25, ACC 32.75 to 1,184.75, ITC 12.0 to 297.0, BSES 15.50 to 210.25 and Reliance Industries 7.50 to 205.0.
